Name: No Kids Ever
Author: ChaoticSimpliciy
Description:
This mod just prevents your spouse from asking if you want children.

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*] Works with Stardew Valley 1.3 on Linux/Mac/Windows.
[*] Works in single-player and multiplayer.
[*] No known mod conflicts.
[/list]
I can not thank Pathos enough for all the help they provided during this project. I am very new to C# and their insights and insane level of patience were invaluable. I don't think I ever would have finished it were it not for their help.

Downloads.Description: For SMAPI 2.10.2 or later. Updated by Pathoschild.

Manifest.Name: No Kids Ever
Manifest.Description: Want to get married, but don't want to be nagged to have a kid? Me too! Now we can!
